blogs.title: Democratizing AI: How to Train a Massive Language Model on a Single GPU
blogs.description: Explore how the QLoRA technique is breaking down the barriers to entry for AI development. This post explains how researchers managed to shrink the memory requirements for finetuning a 65B parameter model from over 780GB to less than 48GB, making it possible for smaller teams and individuals to train state-of-the-art models on a single professional GPU.

blogs.title: Under the Hood of QLoRA: The 3 Innovations Powering Efficient Fine-Tuning
blogs.description: A deep dive into the technical wizardry that makes QLoRA work. We break down the three core innovations: 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) for optimal data storage, Double Quantization to squeeze out every last bit of memory, and Paged Optimizers to prevent those frustrating 'out-of-memory' errors during training.

blogs.title: Meet Guanaco: The Open-Source Chatbot Closing the Gap with ChatGPT
blogs.description: Get to know Guanaco, the high-performing chatbot family born from the QLoRA research. This post covers how Guanaco achieved 99.3% of ChatGPT's performance on the Vicuna benchmark using only 24 hours of training, and why it represents a massive win for the open-source AI community.

blogs.title: Quality Over Quantity: Why Your AI Training Data Needs a Makeover
blogs.description: Based on the analysis of over 1,000 models, this post shares a surprising discovery: the quality of your dataset matters far more than its size. We discuss how a small, high-quality dataset can outperform a massive one and why current chatbot benchmarks might not be telling the whole story.

blogs.title: Can GPT-4 Replace Human Judges? The Truth About AI Evaluation
blogs.description: As we rush to build better chatbots, how do we know if they're actually good? This post explores the research into using GPT-4 as a 'cheap' alternative to human evaluation, highlighting where the AI judge succeeds and where it still falls short of human nuance.
